phases.name: Warm-Up — Machine Activation
phases.goal: Light machine work to get blood into the legs without taxing the muscles before your class. Keep RPE at 5 — this is activation only.

tip.label: Load:
tip.text: Use about 50% of your normal weight. Slow and controlled — full range of motion. This is priming the quads and glutes, not loading them.

tip.label: Tempo:
tip.text: 2 seconds down, 1 second squeeze at the top. Light enough that you could do 20 reps easily. Wakes up the hamstrings without fatiguing them.

phases.name: Machine Block — Moderate Load
phases.goal: Primary machine work. Moderate weight — you should finish each set feeling like you could do 3–4 more reps. Do not go to failure here.

tip.label: Control:
tip.text: Squeeze hard at the top for 1 second, lower slowly over 2 seconds. RPE 6–7 max. Isolates the quad without taxing stabilisers needed for class.

tip.label: Note:
tip.text: Keep hips pressed into the pad. Drive heels toward glutes and hold 1 second at peak contraction. Moderate weight — not a max effort day.

tip.label: Range:
tip.text: Full stretch at the bottom, full extension at the top. Pause 1 second at peak. Calves respond to volume and range — don't cut the ROM short.

phases.name: Free Weight Block — Light & Controlled
phases.goal: Two compound movements at moderate load. Focus is on quality of movement and muscle activation — not how much weight is on the bar. Leave fuel in the tank for class.

tip.label: Key:
tip.text: 3-second eccentric on every rep to maximize hamstring activation with less overall load. Use dumbbells — easier to control than a barbell on a moderate day.

tip.label: Why reverse:
tip.text: Easier on the knees than a forward lunge. Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, drive up through the front heel. Targets quads and glutes without high spinal load.

phases.name: Finisher — Pick One
phases.goal: One light finisher to finish the legs off. Keep it easy — class is next. If you feel fatigued skip this and go straight to cool-down.

options.label: Option A · Machine
options.name: Standing Calf Raise
options.detail: 2 sets × 20 reps. Bodyweight or very light load. Full range, slow tempo. Finishes the calves without adding fatigue to the rest of the leg.

options.label: Option B · Free Weight
options.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat — Pulse
options.detail: 2 sets × 15 reps. Light dumbbell. 3 pulses at the bottom of each rep then drive up. Gets blood into the quads without heavy spinal load.

cards.title: Dynamic Stretch — 5 min
cards.desc: Leg swings, hip circles, walking knee hugs. Dynamic rather than static — keeps the muscles loose and warm for your upcoming class.

cards.title: Hydrate Before Class
cards.desc: Drink at least 16oz of water before your class starts. You've already worked the legs — going in dehydrated will limit performance significantly.
